transform_together_prompt: transform a list of OpenAI-style messages into a TogetherAI-compatible string prompt
transform_text_completion_request: transform an OpenAI text completion request into a TogetherAI completion request dict
validate_together_prompt_tokens: validate that the prompt does not contain integer tokens unsupported by TogetherAI
reject_multiple_prompts: reject prompts containing multiple items since TogetherAI supports only a single prompt
transform_messages_to_string: convert OpenAI message arrays into a single string prompt for TogetherAI
